description.value:
You touch an unenhanced weapon and choose a damage type: acid, cold, energy, fire, ion, kinetic, or lightning. Until the power ends, that weapon becomes an enhanced weapon, gaining a +1 bonus to attack rolls and dealing an extra 1d4 damage of the chosen type on a hit.

Cast with a 5th or 6th level tech slot, the bonus becomes +2 and the extra damage 2d4; cast with a slot of 7th level or higher, the bonus becomes +3 and the extra damage 3d4.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 3
